title: Nekocraft Let's Dance!
description: Replaces some music discs with real life songs!
body:
This resource pack replaces music discs songs from minecraft and modded minecraft so you and your friends (specially if you play on the Nekocraft server) can hear your favourite songs.

If you want any addition, fell free to dm me on Discord!

Here's the Nekoma's discord where YOU can apply to enter the Nekocraft server:
- https://discord.gg/nMFtxqVQ
